comment_regular: Refreshes the equipment attachment cache for the selected skeleton context: either first-person globals or MiddleHighProcess fields (+0xFC Weapon, +0x100 Torch, +0x104 Bip01 L ForearmTwist, +0x108 BackWeapon/SideWeapon selected by native WEAP type, +0x10C Quiver). It pre-clears the matching ArrowBone cache for separate population. The Boolean result is not general cache success; it is NiNode_RemoveScbChildAlongFadeNodeChain(cached Weapon), meaning whether literal Scb was removed.
